title: Integrations
subtitle: Public API keys, webhooks and Microsoft Teams channel notifications.

scope.processes:read: processes, process house, published versions, BPMN and SVG
scope.diagrams:read: value chains, organisation charts, DMN, EPC, SIPOC
scope.objects:read: roles, IT systems, documents, dictionary terms
scope.workflow:cases:read: workflow cases including requester names (personal data)
scope.reporting:read: reporting feed for Power BI and Excel

apiKeys.intro: Keys let other systems read ProcessHub content through the public API.
apiKeys.name: Name
apiKeys.ownerHint: The person responsible for this key. The key stops working when the owner is deactivated.
apiKeys.scopesHint: Read-only. Grant only what the other system needs.
apiKeys.departmentsHint: Empty: all departments. With a selection, items without a department are left out.
apiKeys.ipHint: Optional. IP addresses or CIDR ranges, e.g. 10.20.0.0/16. Empty: any address.
apiKeys.rotateConfirm: Create a new secret? The current one stops working immediately.
apiKeys.revokeConfirm: Revoke this key? Systems using it lose access immediately. This cannot be undone.
apiKeys.secretOnce: This is the only time the key is shown. ProcessHub stores only a fingerprint of it.
apiKeys.secretHint: Send it in the X-API-Key header (or Authorization: Bearer). Store it in the other system's secret store.

webhooks.intro: ProcessHub sends a signed JSON message (HMAC-SHA256) to your HTTPS address when the chosen events happen.
webhooks.name: Name
webhooks.urlHint: The receiver must answer with a 2xx status within 10 seconds. Redirects are not followed.
webhooks.departmentsHint: Empty: all departments. With a selection, events without a department are left out.
webhooks.branchHint: Optional: only events of this process and the processes below it.
webhooks.secretOnce: This is the only time the secret is shown. Use it to check the X-ProcessHub-Signature header.
webhooks.secretHint: See docs/integrations/WEBHOOKS.md for a verification sample.
webhooks.rotateConfirm: Create a new signing secret? The receiver must use the new one from now on.
webhooks.deleteConfirm: Delete this destination? Waiting deliveries are dropped.

teams.intro: Post Adaptive Cards to Microsoft Teams channels through a Teams Workflows webhook ("When a Teams webhook request is received"). Setup: docs/integrations/TEAMS.md.
teams.urlHint: Copy the HTTP POST URL of the Teams workflow. It is stored encrypted and never shown again in full.

webhookSettings.title: Delivery settings
webhookSettings.allowedHostsHint: Optional, e.g. hooks.example.com or *.example.com. Empty: any public host. Internal addresses are always blocked.
